### Handle HTTP protocol errors in the permission lookup (1/2)

**Severity:** `medium`

The permission lookup is intended to fail open, but an `http.client.HTTPException` such as `IncompleteRead` is not covered by the existing exception tuple and can escape `prepare_with_evidence`. Import the standard-library exception type for the following handler.

```suggestion
    import http.client
    try:
```

proposed_comments.title: Handle HTTP protocol errors in the permission lookup (2/2)
proposed_comments.body:
### Handle HTTP protocol errors in the permission lookup (2/2)

**Severity:** `medium`

Add the protocol exception to this fail-open handler. `http.client.IncompleteRead` is an `http.client.HTTPException`, not a `RuntimeError`, `OSError`, or `ValueError`; catching the explicit base class preserves propagation of unrelated programming errors.

```suggestion
    except (RuntimeError, OSError, ValueError, http.client.HTTPException):
```
